meta.title: BioGrid 2.0 reference figures
meta.purpose: Machine-readable register of every externally-sourced quantitative claim used in BioGrid 2.0 documentation. Agents and humans should read figures from here rather than from prose.

grades.A: Replicated peer-reviewed result, published standard, or first-party operator/regulator data. Safe to design against.
grades.B: Peer-reviewed but single-source or narrow-scope, or first-party industry data without independent audit.
grades.C: Trade press, vendor claim, or paywalled analyst summary. Directional only, never load-bearing.
grades.D: Asserted without traceable support. Hypothesis only.

rules: No design decision may rest on a grade C or D figure alone.
Every figure carries source and as_of. A figure without both is removed, not kept.
On review, figures that cannot be re-verified drop to grade D and leave the register.

retracted.claim: UPS ORION uses ant colony optimization
retracted.reason: No supporting source; ORION's public lineage is OR/genetic-algorithm heuristics

retracted.claim: ACO is an IEEE standard used in network routing (RFC 3626)
retracted.reason: RFC 3626 is IETF OLSR, a proactive link-state protocol, not ACO and not IEEE. Correct citations are AntNet and AntHocNet.

retracted.claim: Physarum shortest path complexity O(n log n)
retracted.reason: No such bound. Convergence proven by Bonifaci, Mehlhorn & Varma (2012); each step requires a Laplacian linear solve.
